aside.title: Need a detailed answer?
aside.text: Our solutions team can send a written proposal outline for your program.

items.q: How long does it take to launch a new program?
items.a: A 25-seat program usually goes live in 30 days: one week for hiring, two weeks for training and one week of supervised live traffic.

items.q: Can we interview agents before they join our program?
items.a: Yes. You approve the final shortlist, and your trainers can join the second week of onboarding.

items.q: Which tools do your agents work in?
items.a: Agents log in to your CRM, ticketing and telephony through a secure virtual desktop. We also support Zendesk, Salesforce, Genesys and Freshdesk out of the box.
Most programs are priced per full-time agent per month. Transactional work such as claims processing can be priced per item.

items.q: What happens if quality drops below target?
items.a: The account lead opens a corrective plan within 48 hours and service credits apply as set in the contract.
